beats.headline: Akuma says it in the Warlord Chat
beats.text: As the War Mages quit the floor with the Scavenger's Daughter, Akuma warns Carl and Donut about her in the Warlord Chat: she was forced on the mages as the price of system access, she can slip out through the Waiting Room, and she seeks to kill everybody and everything. He asks them to kill her for him.
